design: Recognizable simple toy bunny, stout seated body, two unmistakable long ears, flat stable underside; neutral warm ivory/wood finish, dark eyes and nose, no baked brightly colored body so runtime tint can distinguish before/after paint. Matte tactile detail visible from overhead. Not a plain ball with tiny ear balls. No plinth.
motion: Whole product travels; no rig or moving ears. Atlas neutral body; document tint limits.
